summary: Re-tested BOM Editor UI after main agent claimed to consolidate the two chained updLine calls into a single setForm. Result: the fix was NOT applied. /app/frontend/src/pages/Masters.jsx line 201 is byte-identical to iteration_2 — still `onValueChange={(v) => { updLine(i, 'material_id', v); updLine(i, 'uom', mUom(v)); }}`. UI repro of the bug confirmed: Masters → BOM → Add BOM → Article X → Material 'Rexine Black' → qty 0.3 → Save produces toast 'Add at least one BOM line' and NO POST /api/boms is fired.
